newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NEWS CORP STARTED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NEWS CORP STARTED AS BUY.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities said Friday analyst Matthew Harrigan started coverage of News Corp with a buy rating.
-- Estimates fiscal 1997 earnings at $1.28 per share, 1998 earnings at $1.24 per share.

-- In a research note, Harrigan said, "A fair 9.0 times EBITDA multiple and at-cost valuations for News' gaggle of startup businesses dictates 1998 price targets of $22.65 for the voting ordinary ARDs and $20.98 for the non-voting preferred ADRs."
